title: IGNOU Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 02 Senior Consultant Posts
description: Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) has published the latest job notification for the recruitment of 02 Senior Consultant Positions. Candidates who have completed their B.E/ B./Tech in Civil Engineering or Electrical Engineering can use this opportunity and apply for the IGNOU Notification 2026 .
